name: Security Bond Attestation
description: Reads public BTC, ETH and SOL wallet holdings, ERC-20/SPL tokens and USD quotes through free APIs. The host caches the result; chain logic stays in WASM.

methods.description: Takes this node's chain addresses ({btc, eth, sol} JSON), fetches each balance from a free public service, prices the total in USD, and returns the attestation JSON. A chain that fails to answer contributes nothing and is named in errors[] — never an invented balance.

wildcardJustification.detail: Host-provided public wallet addresses; ephemeral JSON control input to the HTTP attestor, never persisted as a space record.
Public balance and quote projection returned to the host cache; JSON control result, never inserted into the space-data record store.
